Senses.Explanation: 劫外 means beyond the cosmic aeon. Dongshan Liangjie writes of a withered tree flowering in spring beyond the aeon, while Zhongfeng Mingben writes of spring returning beyond the aeon. These join the earlier uses of spring, light, flowers, and a barrier without establishing a second thing or a timeless essence.
Senses.Note: Prefer the graph-level temporal image. “Timeless,” “eternal,” and metaphysical equivalents say more than the cited passages establish.
